sentences.display: Today, Shisr is part of a UNESCO World Heritage property, the Land of Frankincense.
sentences.tts: Today, Shisr is part of a UNESCO World Heritage property, the Land of Frankincense.

sentences.display: UNESCO describes it not as Iram, but as "the remains of the caravan oasis of Shisr, or Wubar": a station for water on the routes of the incense trade.
sentences.tts: UNESCO describes it not as إِرَم, but as the remains of the caravan oasis of Shisr, or Wubar: a station for water on the routes of the incense trade.
